role: Tests that CloudSessionPayload.uploadable strips every Apple Health reading from an overnight session and an Apple Watch workout (sleep/vitals, VO2max, recent workouts, daytime RHR, segment label, SpO2 penalty, watch HR rows, aiContext HR) while keeping computed scores, that CloudKitSessionFreshness.replacing restores them locally, that HRVAnalysisResult.withANSMetrics copies every field, and that CloudSettingsRecord.scrubbed drops Health-filled profile values.
types: CloudSessionPayloadHealthReadingsTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over upload stripping and restore

units.does: Asserts uploadable(makeNight()) has nil sleep/vitals snapshots, sleep window/segments/adjusted, VO2max and recent workouts (session and analysis training context), daytime resting HR, segment label and autoWindowResult; SpO2 penalty removed (flag false, penalties only 'No sleep data (−5)'); Vitals and Sleep factor details blanked and Sleep facts nil.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts uploadable keeps recoveryScore, frozenReadiness, composite 62, Vitals score 55, CTL 50, nocturnal HR dip/median, RMSSD, overnight nadir HR 49 and the RR point count.
